summary: Estimate daily relative humidity from daily mean temperature and dewpoint and publish it as a new GeoZarr dataset

parameters.name: temperature_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published daily mean temperature collection, e.g. era5land_temperature_daily.

parameters.name: dewpoint_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published daily mean dewpoint collection, e.g. era5land_dewpoint_daily.

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the relative humidity dataset to publish, e.g. era5land_relative_humidity_daily_estimated. Auto-registered if no data source exists.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Variable/band name of the published relative humidity.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings, e.g. ["2024-01-01", "2024-12-31"].
